GENERAL

Jera On Air is an alternative music festival in the south of The Netherlands in the picturesque village of Ysselsteyn, located between Eindhoven and Venlo. Jera On Air is the biggest festival for the punk, hardcore and metalcore lovers in the Netherlands and offers a full weekend with the best bands in the scene. 

2027 is edition #33 of Jera On Air and will take place on 24, 25 and 26 June. With five live music stages, DJ stage, special beergarden, foodcourt, signing sessions, a campsite and many more activities, Jera On Air offers you a fully packed festival experience.
